slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE mapped DOUBLE fields
scope: Extends the existing AC1027 single-field MLEADERSTYLE transaction from group codes 42 and 45 to every existing mapped DOUBLE field represented by the DXF model and writer: groups 40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47, 49, 140, 141, 142 and 143. Each edit is a separate operation on one existing unique source group; the other twelve mapped scalar values remain unchanged.

fieldEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table
fieldEvidence.classification: DXF field-role corroboration. The authored controls validate this adapter path; no independent producer or native semantic acceptance is claimed.

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain exactly one finite DOUBLE for the selected code inside exactly one AcDbMLeaderStyle subclass. Exactly one mapped DOUBLE may change on a record. Common fields, handles, application/extension data and every other encoded payload field must match the baseline.
contract.projection: Select the changed code from an explicit allowlist of the thirteen mapped DOUBLE fields, then replace only its existing physical group in a copy of the captured raw body. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated selected fields, multiple scalar edits, unlisted typed changes, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain refused or on their prior raw-replay route.
contract.outputAndReadback: A runtime-authored AC1027 source contains all thirteen fields once. Each field is edited separately. Staged-output inspection checks the retained raw groups; fresh import requires the selected typed value, the exact literal group/value, and all other twelve typed scalar values to match their source values. Target encoding is alternated across ASCII and binary source runs; the group-42/group-45 receipts separately cover both target encodings for those selected fields.
contract.failureAndRetry: Representative field-specific controls from RPP-5lg/RPP-5lh cover raw-versus-typed conflicts, simultaneous group-42/group-45 typed edits, late typed mutation, destination sentinel rollback, corrected same-adapter retry, and cross-format readback. A boolean landingEnabled edit outside the DOUBLE allowlist is also verified to refuse atomically. These controls are not claimed as independent producer coverage for every field code.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records retain raw replay. Only AC1027 source-to-AC1027 target edits are admitted. Other source/target versions and non-DOUBLE changes are unchanged. No drawing fixture is committed; controls are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: Extended generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp writes one value for each listed group code into STANDARD and preserves a second root-reachable style; ASCII and binary source files are generated locally from scratch.

focusedSelectors.summary: 2/2 passed. The selector independently edits each of the thirteen mapped fields, confirms exact group-code/value output and typed readback, checks the other twelve scalar values stayed unchanged, and exercises ASCII/binary source and output combinations. Representative conflict, multiple-edit refusal, rollback and retry checks pass for groups 42 and 45.

validation.diffCheck: git diff --check; PASS before implementation commit

limitations: The evidence is one authored AC1027 adapter route. It does not establish independent producer variation, native interpretation or rendering, cross-version edits, full MLEADERSTYLE schema coverage, DWG editing, consumer acceptance, or complete document closure.
No support claim is promoted; the support ledger remains closed.
